mechanism: Celecoxib may reduce renal clearance and increase ethambutol concentrations through inhibition of renal tubular secretion and potential reduction in glomerular filtration rate via COX-2 inhibition.
action: Monitor ethambutol serum levels and renal function; consider alternative NSAID or increased monitoring interval; ensure adequate hydration and assess for ethambutol toxicity signs (visual disturbances, peripheral neuropathy).
